description: Biogen and Eisai discontinued the Phase 3 ENGAGE and EMERGE trials of aducanumab in Alzheimer's disease after a pre-specified futility analysis predicted the trials were unlikely to meet their primary endpoint.

source.verified: Biogen investor press release + Eisai news + CNBC/CNN coverage, verified 2026-09-13

event_time_source: futility-analysis data cutoff cited in the press release (the date the futility signal held in the data)
knowable_time_source: Biogen/Eisai discontinuation press release, 2019-03-21 (pre-market; BIIB fell ~29% that session). Verified 2026-09-13.
note_on_stamps: knowable_time (2019-03-21 disclosure) is AFTER event_time (2018-12-26 futility data cutoff) -- the ordinary case, and the mirror image of EVT-001 where an interim topline was disclosed before registry completion. The two orderings together show why the stamps must be recorded separately.

outcome.note: Discontinued for futility on the interim dataset. (The program was later revived in Oct 2019 on a larger dataset and controversially approved in 2021 -- see EVT-003 -- a real example of a revision to what was 'known', which bitemporal storage is meant to capture.)

provenance.fetched_via: web (investor.biogen.com, eisai.com, cnbc.com) via agent tools

disclosure_timing_source: Biogen/Eisai discontinuation press release issued pre-market 2019-03-21 (widely reported; the stock gapped down at the open). Disclosure-timing, not price-derived.
